ExxonMobil's total revenue rose by about **1.45%** from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024. The figures below are from the income statement as I recall them, not checked against the filing here.

| | Fiscal 2023 | Fiscal 2024 |
|---|---|---|
| Total revenues and other income | $344,582 million | $349,585 million |

Change: (349,585 − 344,582) / 344,582 = 5,003 / 344,582 ≈ **+1.45%**

If you count only "Sales and other operating revenue" instead, the figures are $334,697 million and $339,247 million. That gives an increase of about 1.36%.
